recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current build source already satisfies the applied CQI decision, and adding explanatory prose would duplicate the element definitions and risk future drift.
issue_request: FHIR-50664 was an Applied/Persuasive CQI change request for FHIR-core Measure raised for R6. The decision selected option 3 from the ballot note: put calculation-definition metadata in one place by removing the root-level Measure calculation elements and using Measure.group, with related MeasureReport root scoring/improvementNotation cleanup.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation by commits 1278aaf985ed, a78ec3bfb390, and f98976a67811, then merged by HL7/fhir#3811 as 30464797464c. Those commits removed the ballot option note, removed deprecated root-level Measure calculation elements and Measure.type, removed root MeasureReport.scoring and MeasureReport.improvementNotation, and added MeasureReport.group.type.
additional_context: FHIR-50463 was a Resolved - No Change ballot comment that also recommended option 3 and redirected tracking to FHIR-50664. source/fhir.ini lists Measure and MeasureReport as active resources, so the inspected StructureDefinition sources are in current build scope. Later FHIR-55366 work adjusted MeasureReport modifier metadata without reversing the FHIR-50664 group-level placement decision.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Current Measure source lacks the former root calculation elements and retains the corresponding Measure.group elements. Current MeasureReport source lacks root scoring/improvementNotation and contains group.type, group.scoring, group.improvementNotation, and group.improvementNotationGuidance.

related_jiras.note: Resolved - No Change ballot comment that recommended option 3 and directed tracking to FHIR-50664.
Later MeasureReport cleanup removed modifier metadata from the current group-level elements without changing the option 3 placement decision.
